description: Send a message through SPV's contact form ("Formular de contact"): a question or request about the taxpayer's own record, registered at ANAF under the account's name and answered later in SPV as RASPUNS SESIZARE FORMULAR UNIC DE CONTACT. By default a DRY RUN: it reads the live form, checks the message against it and answers it exactly as it would go (identity, category, text without diacritics, attachment with its SHA-256), sending nothing. With dry_run: false it sends, once: it answers the registration number, the date and the text SPV shows. The form preselects its first identity, often a company, so cif is required and read back. The same message is not sent twice unless again: true.

again.description: Send even though this same message was sent, or tried, before.

attachment.description: A file to attach (pdf, tiff, rtf, zip, jpeg, jpg, gif, png, at most 10 MB): a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-_dr30rs0); a bare name is taken from the first. Taken by path only, byte for byte.

attachment_sha256.description: The attachment's hex SHA-256, as sha256sum prints it; a mismatch fails and nothing is sent.

category.description: The form's category. 3 (the default): "Asistență și îndrumare de specialitate în domeniul fiscal", the one answered on the merits.

cif.description: The tax id to write as: one of the form's identities (the dry run lists them). Required: the form preselects the first.

dry_run.description: true (the default): read the form and check the message, send nothing. false: send it to ANAF.

subcategory.description: Only for categories 1, 2 and 5, which require one; the error lists them.

text.description: The message. Sent without diacritics (stripped here) and at most 1,500 characters after that; put a longer wording in an attached PDF.

name: submit_contact_form
title: Write to ANAF (contact form)
